circuit.location: Hard Rock Stadium, Miami Gardens, Florida, U.S.

corners.note: Turn count as given by Wikipedia for this layout. The FIA map numbering is the reference for turn labels.
corners.named_note: No corner names verified for this circuit.

direction.basis: OSM oneway tags / forward roles on the circuit ways
direction.note: Computed from the orientation of the race-direction centreline.

lap_record.note: Fastest lap set during a race (Wikipedia convention: race laps only). 2026-season records are only listed if Wikipedia already shows them.

centreline.s0: Point beside the middle of the OSM pit lane. Approximate start/finish line only.

osm.note: Circuit relation 20204222 (child 20204221) holds untagged geometry only, so the named raceway ways are used

centreline.tumftm_missing_alternative: OpenStreetMap circuit ways (used here, no widths). Better: trace both track edges from aerial imagery or the FIA circuit drawing to get widths.

elevation.note: Computed from a terrain model sampled along the centreline and smoothed over about 30 m. SRTM includes buildings and trees, so on a street circuit the figure is rough. No official elevation figure was verified.

track_width.note: Not verified. No TUMFTM file and no OSM width tags. Measure from aerial imagery or the FIA circuit drawing.

kerbs.note: Kerb types and positions are not published as data. Lines quoted from the FIA Race Director notes ("Changes to the Circuit") where they mention kerbs. The current build derives kerbs from curvature.

osm_hints.note: Only what OSM contributors have mapped near the track; incomplete at most circuits.

run_off.note: Run-off surfaces per corner are not verified. FIA lines quoted where they describe gravel, asphalt, grass, walls or barriers.

track_limits:
Each time a driver fails to respect track limits at Turn 19, will result in that lap time and the
immediately following lap time being invalidated by the Stewards.

pit_lane.speed_limit_source: FIA 2026 F1 Sporting Regulations B1.6.3a default (80 km/h); the Race Director notes do not amend it
pit_lane.side_basis: OSM pit lane position relative to the race-direction centreline
pit_lane.length_note: Length of the OSM pit lane way (usually includes the entry and exit roads). Not an official figure.
pit_lane.fia_entry_exit_rules:
16.1 In accordance with Chapter 4, Articles 4 and 6 of Appendix L to the ISC drivers must follow
the procedures at pit entry and pit exit.
16.2 Pertaining to Chapter 4, Article 4 of Appendix L to the ISC any driver passing to the right-hand side
of the bollard at pit entry will be considered as entering the pit lane.
16.3 Additionally, drivers must keep to the driver’s right of the 1st bollard and to the driver’s left of the
2nd bollard in the Pit Entry Road as highlighted in the image below.
16.4 During the reconnaissance laps prior to the Sprint and the Race drivers are allowed to cross the
white line separating the Pit Exit Road from the circuit.
16.5 For the safe and orderly conduct of the event, during any live session, team personnel are not
allowed in the pit lane beyond the white line crossing the pit lane near pit entry, as indicated in
the picture below.
16.6 The pit exit white line was realigned as per the image bellow.

garages.note: Not verified. The FIA pit lane drawing (fia_map source) shows the garage layout per team.

overtaking.system: 2026 active aero: straight mode zones and overtake mode
overtaking.note: Straight mode (low-drag wing setting) can be used in each zone. The FIA map gives two activation points per zone: one for normal grip and one for low grip (n/a means the zone is not used in low grip). Overtake mode: detection point and activation point. Locations are as printed on the FIA map.

landmarks.note: Grandstands, bridges, tunnels and buildings come from OSM within a few hundred metres of the track (s_m = distance along the pack centreline, side = left/right in race direction). "named" are notable features mentioned in the Wikipedia article, without positions.

sources.what: English Wikipedia article "Miami International Autodrome" (infobox, layout "Grand Prix Circuit (2022–present")
FIA 2026 circuit map, pit lane drawing and emergency exits (Race Director document)
OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL): circuit ways, pit lane, landmarks, run-off hints

osm.note: Circuit relation 20204222 (child 20204221) holds untagged geometry only, so the named raceway ways are used

gaps: No TUMFTM centreline; OSM centreline used, no track widths.
Kerb types and positions not verified as data (only FIA change notes).
Run-off surface per corner not verified (only FIA change notes and OSM hints).
